question: The purpose of this checkpoint The purpose of the checkpoint is to monitor the PFCP session number and rate in UPF (User Plane Function) during BH phase. It passes only when the value is in a specified range. The results depends on the subscriber number and traffic model defined in the case.  We first set the checkpoint range based on the test result when the test case is created then will tune it when it is impacted by expected application behavior change.  Sometimes 1% deviation due to test environment can't be avoided so normally we set the checkpoint range by +- 2%.  EPG Common rule of tuning checkpoints in stability test cases - Cloud Packet Core - PDU Packet Core Confluence  If checkpoint fails, that means the degradation or improvement is more than 2% compared with previous passed build. Need to analyze further to confirm whether there is any unexpected behavior change.  KPIs/Values Checked:           PDCdb_PFCP_sessions  The legacy KPI PDCdb_PFCP_requests_second tracks all three counters combined. It's not easy to do troubleshooting when it failed.
